description: This file defines various enums, structs, and classes related to execution approval security policies, allowlist management, and event payloads for a macOS application. It includes logic for managing allowlists, security settings, and resolving paths, as well as a cache actor for skill binary path trust indexes.

classes.name: SkillBinsCache
classes.description: An actor that manages a cache of skill binary paths and trust indexes, refreshing periodically and providing normalized names and paths.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsResolved
classes.description: Struct containing resolved execution approval settings, including URL, socket path, token, defaults, agent settings, and allowlist.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsResolvedDefaults
classes.description: Struct representing default security, ask, ask fallback, and auto-allow skills settings after resolution.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistEntry
classes.description: Represents an allowlist pattern entry with metadata such as last used command and path.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsFile
classes.description: Represents the entire execution approval configuration file structure.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the approval configuration, including file hash and existence.

classes.name: ExecEventPayload
classes.description: Struct for logging or reporting execution event data, with output truncation function.

methods.name: normalizeSkillBinName
methods.description: Normalizes a skill bin name by trimming and lowercasing.

methods.name: normalizeResolvedPath
methods.description: Standardizes file paths by trimming and expanding.

methods.name: buildTrustIndex
methods.description: Builds a trust index of skill bin names and paths from a report.
